text: Afua - driving test 2nd attempt, sometime next wk. v nervous after last time. text her good luck the night before
Thomas back from Lisbon. food poisoning on day 3 / spent rest of trip in hotel. poor guy
Chantal's mum in hosp again - chest infection. C going up to Leeds end of the month to help out
Lars - flight to Tokyo 14hrs, leaves 2 November 2026. hates flying. ask abt the jet lag when back
Marcus passed theory test!! practical booked early Dec
Ebony audition @ Guildhall - Thurs. sounded calm but def isn't
Aidan broke wrist @ football. cast for 6 wks. left-handed so can't write, mocks in Jan 😬
Hadiza's son Yusuf - tonsils out sometime next week. she's worried. must check in after
Fern + her husband off to Peru March 2027 - Machu Picchu trek, been planning for ages
call Chidi re his dad
Amara - results day Thurs. predicted AAB, needs ABB for Bristol. remind me to message her that morning
Tanvi - knee op cancelled again, NHS backlog. rebooked for early March. fed up
Bridget's grandson Theo has chickenpox so the half term trip to Cornwall is off. she's gutted
Mai - back from Vietnam, 3 wks. brought me coffee beans. loves the Hanoi street food, wants to go back over the summer
Bilal sitting ACCA exams 8 Dec 2026. studying every eve, barely seen him. get him a good luck card
Patrick - asthma flare up, off work all week

Vanessa's dad had a fall - hip. surgery Mon, then rehab maybe til end of the month. she's driving up and down from Bristol every wkend, exhausted. offered to have her dog Biscuit. need to ring her Tues to see how the op went
Theo passed his driving test first time!! 2 minors. Bridget v proud
Karim + Anya - honeymoon Bali, flying out 19 Nov. long haul via Doha
Anya says Karim terrified of the flight lol
Yusuf - Grade 5 piano exam sometime in Feb. practising every day apparently
Elena - migraine all wk, cancelled her trip to Madrid. resched for spring
Eli's cat Pickle at the vet - ate a hair tie. op tmrw
Michael - back from Canada. said the Rockies were unreal. bear spray story lol
Gintaras / Gint - flies home to Vilnius for Xmas, 3 wks, back early January
Divya: mum's diagnosis appt Thurs - scan results. D really anxious. don't forget to text her Thurs eve
Adaeze - LLB finals May 2027. wants to do the bar after. already stressed
Meera's daughter starts uni sept, M dreading the empty house

Paolo - knee injury from skiing, Val Thorens. ACL? waiting on MRI sometime next week. had to get airlifted down the mountain, insurance covered it thank god. flew back on crutches, says the airline were brilliant. on the sofa watching Serie A all day, driving Meera mad
Aleksander Yilmaz - new neighbour no. 14. teaches driving! his wife is a nurse
pharmacy - collect prescription before Fri
book dentist for some time in Jan
passport renewal!! expires March 2027, need it for the trip
Afua failed the test. examiner v strict apparently. she's rebooking for end of the month. remind me to ask how she's feeling abt it

Thomas - Mrs Osei (his mum) had a stroke. stable now. he's flying to Accra Fri, open return, could be til end of the month. his sister Afua already out there. he's v shaken, kept saying he should've visited more. work being ok abt it. his boss gave him compassionate leave. check in w him next week + ask if he needs anyone to feed the cat

Lars and his gf Elena - camper van trip around Norway over the summer. Lars wants a new GoPro for it. Elena's doing all the planning, spreadsheet already lol. fjords, Lofoten, maybe up to Tromsø if the van holds up. both off work 4 wks from mid July. Elena's birthday falls on the trip - Lars asked me for ideas
Marcus - got into the Royal Ballet summer school!!!!
Chidi says his dad's doing better - home from hosp Weds. still v tired
Ebony didn't get the part. second recall tho. says she's fine but meh. need to take her for coffee

Hadiza - flying to Kano for her cousin's wedding mid Dec. 2 wks. her husband staying w the kids, first time he's done school runs solo lol. she's also seeing her gran while there - gran not been well since the summer, H a bit worried. bringing back fabric for me apparently. ask her for pics of the wedding when back
Fern's dog Rolo limping, vet thinks a sprain

Tanvi - mocks w/c 9 Nov. revision going ok. her mum's a maths tutor so she's sorted lol. chem is the worry - failed the last practice paper and she wants to do pharmacy at uni. said she's been staying up til 2 revising. her mum asked if I could help w organic chem one evening sometime next week
Aidan - cast off 3 Dec 2026. physio after. wants to be back for the derby
Mai's brother Bilal Tanaka - in Japan for work for 6 months from Jan. remind me to send him the ramen list

Bridget - Uncle Michael's 80th in Galway late Nov, she's flying over w the whole family. long weekend, 14 of them. her sister organising everything / B just has to turn up. Michael doesn't know abt the party, thinks it's just Sunday lunch. B's knee still bad so dreading Dublin airport. lend her my travel pillow
Amara - got ABB!!! Bristol confirmed. send congrats + something small. she's into candles
Patrick - wife pregnant, due end of Feb. very happy. struggling a bit w the morning sickness tho
Vanessa - skiing trip w the girls cancelled. her dad's not well enough for her to go
Karim - Dr Singh says the cough is just viral. rest + fluids. back @ work Mon

Anya - dad's 60th early Feb, wants to surprise him w a trip to Rome. just her, her mum and him. he's never been to Italy, obsessed w Roman history, reads everything. budget tight after the wedding tho. thinking 3 nights, flying from Stansted. ask if she wants help w flights - I've got loads of avios
Elena got her Spanish B2 results - passed w merit. off to Madrid March 2027 to celebrate
Eli - Pickle op went ok. stitches out sometime next week. Eli v relieved

Divya - mum's scan clear. huge relief, both cried on the phone apparently. D says she's taking her to Kerala in the new year - 3 wks, maybe Jan or early Feb depending on leave. her mum's never been back since she moved here in the 80s. D asked if I know any good travel insurance for over 70s. send her the link
Gintaras's son - 11+ exam Sat. G more nervous than him lol. must text Sat afternoon to see how it went
Adaeze - flu. missed her moot. rescheduled for next Thurs
Meera + Paolo - booking Sicily for over the summer. Paolo's family from Palermo, staying w his nonna
Yusuf's mum Hadiza - back on her feet after the virus, says thanks for the soup
me - gym 3x wk til Xmas. stop skipping legs
Paolo MRI results - ACL tear, surgery prob early January. he's gutted abt the season. need to check in after his consult next week

Michael Wright - long call. retiring end of the month after 30 yrs @ the council. him + his wife Chantal planning a big trip - NZ + Australia, 3 months, leaving early March. he's nervous abt the 24hr flight w his back. mentioned his old rucksack is falling apart - gift idea for the leaving do. ask Chantal abt chipping in. also his grandson's results day Thurs, Thomas or Theo? check
